rules.cite: LAMC ch. XV, art. 1 (Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.quote:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%
rules.requirement: For RSO units, the annual allowable rent increase for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 is 3%. Beginning February 2, 2026, no additional percentage for utilities may be included.
rules.title: LA RSO annual allowable rent increase 3%
